values.note: 2026 (city's rates page): electric $36/day ($220/week, $684/month), full hookup $42/day ($255/week, $824/month), rustic $20, cabin $57. One rate for everyone (no resident/non-resident split posted). Campspot adds the park's $6 'online processing' fee once per stay. November hunters' season: $100/week, by phone.

values.note: Summer season May 15 - October 14, weather permitting. A fall hunters' season, November 1-30, by phone only: self-contained campers, electric and dump station only, no water hookups.

summary: Confirmed on the city's own site (2026): electric $36 / full hookup $42 per day (one rate, no resident split), 50-amp full hookups with water and sewer, hot showers and sanitation station, season May 15 - Oct 14, reservable on Campspot ($6 processing fee per stay); phone (989) 324-8017 matches. Added the November hunters' season, max rig 70 ft and pull-throughs from Campspot. Site count 58 not restated (Campspot lists 52 sites); left. Note unchanged.
